messages.subject: lgcppredictSpatialINLA
parts:
Hy everyone,

I have to predict the latent intensity function of a Log Gaussian Cox process. I have already implemented MALA by using R package lgcp with the command lgcpredcitspatial.

Now in order to make comparison I would like to predict the intensity using INLA. I have use the command lgcppredictSPatialINLA and it seems to work preety nice. However when I try to get the intensity of the LGCP by using the command intens() the console tells me :

 Error in UseMethod("intens") : 
  no applicable method for 'intens' applied to an object of class "c('lgcpPredictINLA', 'lgcpobject')"

I hope that someone can help, please I am very desperate I need to figure it out.

Thanks in advance for your time,

Best regards

Alessandro Picca
